name: orbtile-start
description: Checks whether the Orbtile app is set up for Codex and points you to it until it is. Quiet once Orbtile is installed.

interface.longDescription: Checks whether the Orbtile app is installed and connected to Codex, and tells you the next step. Until Orbtile is installed it shows one line a day at session start that points to orbtile.com/download. It reads local files only and sends nothing anywhere.
